answer: Each identity must log signed Bluetooth encounters with five distinct verified identities per epoch, each encounter a short-range signal exchange timestamped by both parties. A sybil farm can only encounter itself, so its fakes form a disconnected island in the encounter graph while honest identities link into one mesh. Every extra fake needs five fresh encounters or joins the island, which verifiers spot at once. Encounter logs sit on-chain, and graph analysis from a high mesa of the whole network exposes any cluster whose links never touch honest nodes.
